slides.say: Need a Transition outside a component, like in a data library? Import start transition directly.
It works like the one from use transition. Updates made during the call are marked as Transitions.
The function runs immediately. Updates in a set timeout happen later, so they are not marked as Transitions.

slides.text: No isPending here. Need a spinner? Use useTransition.
slides.say: One difference: it gives you no is pending flag. For a pending indicator, use the Hook.
